name: Md Naim Babu
about: I am a Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) undergraduate from Pundra University of Science and Technology, Bangladesh. I am driven by curiosity in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Human-Centered Research.
mission: My long-term goal is to become an AI/ML Research Engineer and pursue higher studies abroad to work on impactful research problems.

projects.title: Stress Detection Using Keystroke Dynamics
projects.subtitle: Current Thesis Project
projects.description: A thesis-focused system that engineers keystroke patterns, applies regression-based ML models, and predicts human stress from typing behavior.

projects.title: Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Detection
projects.subtitle: Medical Image Classification
projects.description: A deep learning workflow using EfficientNetB4 in PyTorch for classifying pneumonia from chest X-ray images with strong AUC performance.

projects.title: Brain Tumor Detection
projects.subtitle: CNN-based Medical Imaging
projects.description: A CNN-driven model for identifying potential brain tumors from imaging data using deep learning and robust preprocessing.

projects.title: Secure National ID Management System
projects.subtitle: Systems + Security
projects.description: A secure desktop system built with C, GTK, SQLite, and OpenSSL for encrypted data handling and robust identity operations.

projects.title: Mental Health Prediction
projects.subtitle: Machine Learning Project
projects.description: A machine learning pipeline for predicting mental health indicators from structured behavioral data.
